name: Embryo_Track
description: Predicts gestation days from cranial ultrasound measurements (cranio-occipital and temporo-temporal length) for pregnancies with 1-3 embryos. Uses polynomial reference curves fitted to species-specific craniometry data with support for custom reference dataset loading.
